validation_queries.description: Check for hipFile PMC metric descriptions
validation_queries.error_message: No hipFile PMC info rows found in rocpd_info_pmc
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM {table_name} WHERE name LIKE 'hipFile GPU%'

validation_queries.description: Check for hipFile file registration counter description
validation_queries.error_message: hipFile 'File Registrations' PMC info not found
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM {table_name} WHERE symbol = 'File Registrations'

validation_queries.description: Check for hipFile buffer registration counter description
validation_queries.error_message: hipFile 'Buffer Registrations' PMC info not found
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM {table_name} WHERE symbol = 'Buffer Registrations'

validation_queries.description: Check for hipFile PMC counter events in trace
validation_queries.error_message: No hipFile PMC events found in rocpd_pmc_event
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM {table_name} event JOIN rocpd_info_pmc info ON event.pmc_id = info.id WHERE info.name LIKE 'hipFile GPU%'

validation_queries.description: Check that at least one hipFile registration counter is non-zero
validation_queries.error_message: hipFile registration counters were all zero
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM {table_name} event JOIN rocpd_info_pmc info ON event.pmc_id = info.id WHERE info.symbol IN ('File Registrations', 'Buffer Registrations') AND event.value > 0
